function.name: propose_patch
function.description: Propose the new right-hand side of `let refund_amount = ...;`. Returns a refusal, a counterexample, or the Lean proposition to prove.

expression.description: Only the expression, without `let` and without the semicolon, made of requested_refund, *deposited, balance_left, unsigned integer literals, parentheses and .min(...).

function.name: write_solution
function.description: Submit the whole content of Solution.lean: the proof of the proposition propose_patch returned. Returns ACCEPTED or the errors.
